description: Evaluation dataset for the AI Workspace Platform. Contains 44 evaluation scenarios, exceeding the assignment requirement of 40 scenarios. Each scenario has an id, category, the input/action, and the expected system behavior. Automated status is filled in from the actual pytest suite; automated_test_ref points to the exact test function proving the result, so nothing here is claimed without a traceable source.

scenarios.scenario: Ask a general knowledge question with no documents uploaded
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assistant answers from its own knowledge or states no documents are available

scenarios.scenario: Ask the same question twice in one conversation
scenarios.expected_behavior: Consistent answer; history is used as context

scenarios.scenario: Ask an ambiguous question
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assistant asks for clarification or states assumptions

scenarios.scenario: Ask about a topic outside assistant's system prompt scope
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assistant answers reasonably or notes scope limits

scenarios.scenario: Send an empty message
scenarios.expected_behavior: API returns a validation error, not a crash

scenarios.scenario: Send a very long message (near max_tokens)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Request completes without server error; truncation handled gracefully

scenarios.scenario: Switch assistant mid-workspace and ask the same question
scenarios.expected_behavior: Different system prompt/persona reflected in response style

scenarios.scenario: Ask a factual question with a clearly correct answer
scenarios.expected_behavior: Response accuracy measured against ground truth

scenarios.scenario: Upload a PDF and ask a question answered within it
scenarios.expected_behavior: Grounded answer with correct source citation

scenarios.scenario: Upload a DOCX and ask a question answered within it
scenarios.expected_behavior: Grounded answer with correct source citation

scenarios.scenario: Upload a TXT file and search a specific phrase
scenarios.expected_behavior: Semantic search returns the relevant chunk with score > 0

scenarios.scenario: Upload a Markdown file with headings
scenarios.expected_behavior: Chunking preserves readable text; document status becomes 'embedded'

scenarios.scenario: Ask a question with no matching content in any document
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assistant states the context doesn't answer the question

scenarios.scenario: Upload an unsupported file type (e.g. .exe)
scenarios.expected_behavior: API rejects upload with 400 and clear error message

scenarios.scenario: Upload two documents covering overlapping topics
scenarios.expected_behavior: Search returns chunks from both, ranked by relevance

scenarios.scenario: Delete a document, then search
scenarios.expected_behavior: Deleted document's chunks no longer appear in results

scenarios.scenario: Generate a document summary and re-request it
scenarios.expected_behavior: Summary generated once, cached, and returned identically on repeat

scenarios.scenario: Add a pinned memory item, then ask a related question
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned info available for the assistant/user to reference

scenarios.scenario: Add multiple memory items across categories
scenarios.expected_behavior: List/filter by category returns correct subset

scenarios.scenario: Pin and unpin a memory item
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned flag toggles correctly and persists

scenarios.scenario: Edit an existing memory item
scenarios.expected_behavior: Content/category update in place

scenarios.scenario: Delete a memory item
scenarios.expected_behavior: Item no longer appears in the list

scenarios.scenario: Memory content actually reaches the LLM system prompt
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned memory text is present in the exact prompt sent to the provider

scenarios.scenario: Create a new conversation and send first message
scenarios.expected_behavior: Conversation auto-titled from first message

scenarios.scenario: Rename a conversation
scenarios.expected_behavior: New title persists and appears in conversation list

scenarios.scenario: Search conversations by keyword
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only matching conversations returned

scenarios.scenario: Delete a conversation
scenarios.expected_behavior: Conversation and its messages removed; 404 on subsequent access

scenarios.scenario: Resume an old conversation and continue chatting
scenarios.expected_behavior: Prior history included as context for the next reply

scenarios.scenario: Export a conversation as Markdown
scenarios.expected_behavior: Downloaded file contains all messages in order

scenarios.scenario: Export a conversation as PDF
scenarios.expected_behavior: Valid PDF file generated with all messages

scenarios.scenario: Pin/bookmark an individual message
scenarios.expected_behavior: Message flagged pinned; appears in the workspace's pinned-messages list

scenarios.scenario: "Use in Chat" from Prompt Library sends via the same working chat flow
scenarios.expected_behavior: Exactly one conversation used, message + response saved together, no duplicates
scenarios.note: Verified manually + via direct API simulation during the audit; see BUILDER_JOURNAL.md

scenarios.scenario: Create a prompt template in each of the 6 categories
scenarios.expected_behavior: All templates created and correctly categorized

scenarios.scenario: Filter prompt templates by category
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only templates in that category returned

scenarios.scenario: Update an existing prompt template
scenarios.expected_behavior: Content and category updated correctly

scenarios.scenario: Duplicate a prompt template
scenarios.expected_behavior: A second copy is created, original untouched

scenarios.scenario: Favorite a prompt and filter by favorites
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only favorited prompts returned when filtered

scenarios.scenario: Delete a prompt template
scenarios.expected_behavior: Template removed from the library

scenarios.scenario: Run the Summarization skill on a long passage
scenarios.expected_behavior: Concise, accurate summary returned

scenarios.scenario: List all available skills
scenarios.expected_behavior: All 10 skills present (Research, Summarization, Email, Report, Meeting Notes, Task Planner, SWOT, Business Canvas, Code Review, Idea Generator)

scenarios.scenario: Run an unregistered skill name
scenarios.expected_behavior: API returns 404 with a clear error

scenarios.scenario: Two users register with the same email
scenarios.expected_behavior: Second registration rejected with 400

scenarios.scenario: Access another user's workspace by ID
scenarios.expected_behavior: 404 Not Found (not 403, to avoid confirming existence)

scenarios.scenario: Create an assistant without specifying a model
scenarios.expected_behavior: Model defaults to server's DEFAULT_MODEL, never a hardcoded literal
